title: Shared sign-in for the shared tier: one Google client, tenancy from deployment and membership
description: One shared Google OAuth client and Cognito client for every shared-tier deployment. authorize takes the deployment, checks the token is bound to it (host or audience), the Account owns the deployment and the person is a member, and returns capabilities combined with billing standing. Reader subjects become pairwise per deployment.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan, 2026-11-09: the design partner's three new sites launch directly on the shared tier at Papyrus M7, never as dedicated sites. This is required for the partner launch at M7, not a later migration. Priority raised to 1.
